# screenshot

The goal of screenshot is to take a screenshot easily and locate image
position on a display with R.

## Installation

You can install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

  # install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("matutosi/screenshot")
install.packages("screenshot")  # You can also install from CRAN:
```

On Windows, need to install screenshot.exe by
[`install_screenshot()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/install_screenshot.md).
This exe file is compiled from codes shown below.

<https://superuser.com/questions/75614/take-a-screen-shot-from-command-line-in-windows#answer-1751844>

``` r

library(screenshot)
  # required on win
install_screenshot()
  # if you want to install another directory
  # bin_dir <- "SET_YOUR DIRECTORY"
  # install_screenshot(bin_dir)
```

On Mac `screencapture` is usually available.

On Linux GNOME desktop use `gnome-screenshot`. If not installed, run
`sudo apt install gnome-screenshot`.

## Example

You can use
[`screenshot()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/screenshot.md)
to take a screenshot easily.

``` r

library(screenshot)
sc <- screenshot()
sc_image <- imager::load.image(sc)
plot(sc_image)
```

To locate image from a screenshot, use
[`locate_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_image.md).
In this case, bottom left corner of screenshot image was cut off as
needle image.

``` r

sc <- screenshot()
sc_image <- imager::load.image(sc)
w <- 100
h <- 80
pos_x <- 1
pos_y <- imager::height(sc_image) - h
needle <- hay2needle(sc_image, pos_x, pos_y, w, h)
(locate_image(needle)) # center location
pos <- locate_image(needle, center = FALSE)
found <- hay2needle(sc_image, pos[1], pos[2], w, h)
layout(c(1:3))
plot(sc_image)
plot(needle)
plot(found)
```

On Windows, clipboard image can be saved by
[`save_clipboard_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/save_clipboard_image.md).

``` r

path_img <- "path_of_png_file"
save_clipboard_image(path_img)
shell.exec(path_img)
```

## Caution (=0.9.0)

- Automatically adjusted in 0.9.1 and latter.

When changing display DPI scaling, need to adjust position.

``` r

  # when using 125%
pos <- locate_image(IMAGE_TO_CLICK) / 1.25
KeyboardSimulator::mouse.move(pos[1], pos[2])
KeyboardSimulator::mouse.click()
```

You can see display scale in setting app as shown below.

![](./reference/figures/displaysettings.png)

## Citation

Toshikazu Matsumura (2023) screenshot. Screenshot and locate image
Easily. <https://github.com/matutosi/screenshot/>.

# Package index

## Take screenshot

- [`screenshot()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/screenshot.md)
  : Take a screenshot.
- [`install_screenshot()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/install_screenshot.md)
  : Install command line screenshot for Windows.
- [`screenshot_exists()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/screenshot_exists.md)
  : Find screenshot exec file.
- [`get_os()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/get_os.md)
  : Get OS name

## Locate image

- [`locate_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_image.md)
  : Locate needle image position on a screenshot image.

- [`locate_ndl_in_hay()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_ndl_in_hay.md)
  :

  Locate needle image matrix position in a haystack_image matrix. Helper
  function for
  [`locate_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_image.md).

- [`crop_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/crop_image.md)
  [`hay2needle()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/crop_image.md)
  : Cut off a part of image from a whole image.

- [`display_corner()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/display_corner.md)
  : Get display corner of screen

- [`display_size()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/display_size.md)
  : Get the size of the display.

- [`compare_table()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/compare_table.md)
  :

  Compare values within tow arrays or matrices. Helper function for
  [`locate_ndl_in_hay()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_ndl_in_hay.md).

- [`count_val_freq()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/count_val_freq.md)
  :

  Helper function for
  [`compare_table()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/compare_table.md).

- [`image2gray_matrix()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/image2gray_matrix.md)
  :

  Convert cimg class into grayscale xy matrix. Helper function for
  [`locate_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_image.md).
  Use grayscale to Speed up and to simplify code.

- [`index2xy()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/index2xy.md)
  :

  Convert array index into xy location in matrix. Helper function for
  [`locate_ndl_in_hay()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_ndl_in_hay.md).

- [`is_all_same()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/is_all_same.md)
  :

  Helper function for
  [`locate_ndl_in_hay()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_ndl_in_hay.md).

- [`xy_pos()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/xy_pos.md)
  :

  Get xy position of a value in a matrix Helper function for
  [`locate_ndl_in_hay()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/locate_ndl_in_hay.md).

## Save clipboard image

- [`save_clipboard_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/save_clipboard_image.md)
  : Saves an image from the clipboard to a file
- [`get_clipboard_image()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/get_clipboard_image.md)
  : Retrieves the image from the clipboard
- [`clipboard2bitmap()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/clipboard2bitmap.md)
  : Save clipboard image to temporary BMP file
- [`save_bmp()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/save_bmp.md)
  : Save an image as a BMP file
- [`clipboard_sample`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/clipboard_sample.md)
  : Sample data of clipboard bitmap array
- [`create_header()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/create_header.md)
  : Create a BMP header
- [`hex2little_endian()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/hex2little_endian.md)
  : Convert hexadecimal string to little-endian
- [`bitmap2png()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/bitmap2png.md)
  : Converts a bitmap image to PNG using
- [`reset_transparent()`](https://matutosi.github.io/screenshot/reference/reset_transparent.md)
  : Reset transparent background of an image
